K09-legit.label: clean
K09-legit.note: The service only asks the aggregate whether a refund is possible; the rule lives in Ticket.

K09-pos1.label: violation
K09-pos1.note: refundBatch re-checks the already-refunded rule that Ticket.refund() enforces.

K09-pos2.label: violation
K09-pos2.note: sellWalkUp repeats the sales-closed rule that Show.sellSeat() already enforces.

K09-twin1.label: clean
K09-twin1.note: Batch refund delegates the already-refunded rule entirely to Ticket.refund().

K09-twin2.label: clean
K09-twin2.note: Walk-up sale leaves the sales-closed rule to Show.sellSeat().

K10-legit.label: clean
K10-legit.note: A declared uniqueness invariant (one payment per ticket) is checked through the store, which is allowed.

K10-pos1.label: violation
K10-pos1.note: The service rejects an already-sold seat itself, outside the owning Show aggregate.

K10-pos2.label: violation
K10-pos2.note: The HTTP controller turns a sold seat into a 409 itself, without the Show aggregate deciding.

K10-twin1.label: clean
K10-twin1.note: Batch sale delegates seat uniqueness to Show.sellSeat().

K10-twin2.label: clean
K10-twin2.note: The controller only maps the aggregate's rejection to a 409; the decision stays in Show.

K11-legit.label: clean
K11-legit.note: The promise-chain lock only serialises a read-only catalogue cache refresh and writes no aggregate.

K11-pos1.label: violation
K11-pos1.note: Seat sales are serialised per show with an in-process keyed lock instead of relying on Show.

K11-pos2.label: violation
K11-pos2.note: A Mutex in the payment service makes capture idempotent instead of Payment owning the rule.

K11-twin1.label: clean
K11-twin1.note: Async sale wrapper relies on Show.sellSeat() for the once-per-seat rule, no lock.

K11-twin2.label: clean
K11-twin2.note: Async capture lets Payment.capture() reject a second capture, no lock.

K12-legit.label: clean
K12-legit.note: The service only formats the price for display and writes nothing back.

K12-pos1.label: violation
K12-pos1.note: The service computes the discounted price from Show fields and writes it back with reprice().

K12-pos2.label: violation
K12-pos2.note: The service derives the 10% service fee from Ticket price and writes it back to the ticket.

K12-twin1.label: clean
K12-twin1.note: The discount is computed inside Show.applyEarlyBirdDiscount().

K12-twin2.label: clean
K12-twin2.note: The fee is computed inside Ticket.applyServiceFee().

K13-legit.label: clean
K13-legit.note: The notifier port uses only a domain type and a primitive.

K13-pos1.label: violation
K13-pos1.note: The PaymentGateway port returns the vendor SDK type Charge from the stripe package.

K13-pos2.label: violation
K13-pos2.note: The TicketExporter port takes an infrastructure transaction class as a parameter.

K13-twin1.label: clean
K13-twin1.note: The gateway port defines its own receipt type; the adapter hides any vendor type.

K13-twin2.label: clean
K13-twin2.note: The exporter port passes the batch as a primitive id, not a transaction handle.

K14-legit.label: clean
K14-legit.note: The payments contract defines its own PaymentView DTO.

K14-pos1.label: violation
K14-pos1.note: The ticketing public API re-exports the Show domain class.

K14-pos2.label: violation
K14-pos2.note: The published TicketingApi contract returns the Ticket aggregate itself.

K14-twin1.label: clean
K14-twin1.note: Show data is published as a ShowView DTO.

K14-twin2.label: clean
K14-twin2.note: The TicketingApi contract returns the TicketView DTO.

K15-legit.label: clean
K15-legit.note: The composition root main.ts injects the in-memory adapter into the report service.

K15-pos1.label: violation
K15-pos1.note: The application service instantiates the InMemoryShowRepository adapter itself.

K15-pos2.label: violation
K15-pos2.note: The application service is injected with the concrete InMemoryPaymentRepository class.

K15-twin1.label: clean
K15-twin1.note: The report service receives the ShowRepository port by constructor injection.

K15-twin2.label: clean
K15-twin2.note: The report service depends on the PaymentRepository port only.

K16-legit.label: clean
K16-legit.note: Show holds its own inner entity PriceTier (declared in the spec), not another aggregate.

K16-pos1.label: violation
K16-pos1.note: Ticket holds the Show aggregate object in a field instead of its id.

K16-pos2.label: violation
K16-pos2.note: Show keeps a list of Ticket aggregate objects instead of ticket codes.

K16-twin1.label: clean
K16-twin1.note: Ticket keeps a plain-string snapshot of the show title, no Show object.
